title: Insufficient parameter sanitization in the AMD Secure Processor (ASP) trusted execution environment (TEE) SPDM driver…
description: A vulnerability in the AMD Secure Processor (ASP) trusted execution environment (TEE) SPDM driver involves insufficient parameter sanitization. This flaw could allow an attacker with limited privileges to supply malicious input, potentially causing loss of platform integrity, memory leakage, or denial of service.
